def test_equal_strings():
    assert levenshtein("hello", "hello") == 0

def test_case_sensitivity():
    assert levenshtein("Hello", "hello") == 1

def test_insertions():
    assert levenshtein("cat", "cats") == 1
    assert levenshtein("dog", "dogs") == 1

def test_deletions():

    assert levenshtein("dogs", "dog") == 1

def test_substitutions():
    assert levenshtein("cat", "bat") == 1

def test_mixed_operations():
    assert levenshtein("kitten", "sitting") == 3
    assert levenshtein("sunday", "saturday") == 3
    assert levenshtein("flaw", "lawn") == 2
    assert levenshtein("gumbo", "gambol") == 2

def test_swaps_not_considered_single_operation():
    # Standard Levenshtein distance for a swap is 2
    assert levenshtein("ab", "ba") == 2
    assert levenshtein("abc", "acb") == 2

def test_unicode_and_special_characters():
    assert levenshtein("café", "cafe") == 1  # é vs e
    assert levenshtein("naïve", "naive") == 1
    assert levenshtein("héllo", "hello") == 1
    assert levenshtein("hello, world!", "hello world") == 2  # comma, exclamation

    s2 = "b" * 1000
    assert levenshtein(s1, s2) == 1000  # all substitutions

    assert levenshtein("a", "bcd") == levenshtein("bcd", "a")
